snippet.title: Testing “An Hei Po Huai Shen” (Diablo II) on NES - 9 Minute Gameplay
snippet.description:
Welcome to my channel! In this video, I dive into “An Hei Po Huai Shen,” also known as Diablo II, a fascinating backport of the classic Diablo game to the NES by Shenzhen Nanjing. This turn-based RPG offers a unique twist on the original Diablo experience, complete with NES-style music from games like Golden Sun and Diablo. Join me as I explore the gameplay, encounter some nostalgic dialogue, and see how this backport holds up on both emulators and real hardware. Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more retro gaming content!

#DiabloIINES #RetroGaming #NESBackport #TurnBasedRPG
